description.value: Angus T is a Belgian-style croissant bakery founded in 2016 in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, built around a family recipe passed down through generations from a small Belgian village. All pastries are handcrafted daily in an open kitchen using locally and European-sourced ingredients, spanning an extensive menu of sweet and savory croissants, cinnamon buns, babka buns, and specialty coffee. A touring cyclist stopping in will find a broad selection of quick, filling baked goods and café drinks in a warm indoor seating environment.
